subtopics.title: Digital Platforms and Online Gaming
subtopics.summary: A US jury found Meta Platforms and YouTube liable for addictive platform design, shifting attention from content to design. India's Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 prohibits online money gaming, and the PROG Rules 2026 take effect from 1 May 2026. UPI completed 10 years in 2026 as a leading real-time payment system.
facts: US jury found Meta Platforms and YouTube guilty of designing addictive platforms
Addictive features included endless scrolling and algorithm-driven feeds
Liability split: Meta about 70 per cent, YouTube about 30 per cent
Total compensation in the case: USD 6 million
Court avoided Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act, 1996; platforms treated as products
PROG Rules 2026 notified by MeitY, effective from 1 May 2026
Online Gaming Act 2025 prohibits online money gaming and permits e-sports and social games
Regulator: Online Gaming Authority of India (MeitY); final appeal lies to Secretary, MeitY
UPI completed 10 years in 2026; NPCI established in 2008
UPI operates under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007

subtopics.title: International Relations
subtopics.summary: The United States and Iran agreed to a 2-week ceasefire after a prolonged conflict, with formal peace talks planned from 11 April 2026 in Islamabad. The ceasefire is conditional, and the US excluded Lebanon from it. India and South Korea elevated ties to a Futuristic Partnership under a Joint Strategic Vision during President Lee Jae-myung's visit.
facts: US and Iran agreed to a 2-week ceasefire after a prolonged conflict
Formal peace talks to begin on 11 April 2026 in Islamabad, led by US VP JD Vance
Iran agreed to reopen the Strait of Hormuz for 2 weeks
US demands complete dismantling of Natanz, Isfahan and Fordow nuclear sites
US excludes Lebanon from the ceasefire
India-South Korea ties elevated to a Futuristic Partnership under a Joint Strategic Vision
India and South Korea signed 4 MoUs during President Lee Jae-myung's visit
Maritime cooperation: KOICA to map workforce gaps and set up a joint shipbuilding training centre
South Korea joins International Solar Alliance and Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative
2028-29 declared as Year of India-ROK Friendship with focus on K-Pop, cinema and sports

subtopics.title: Polity, Governance and Schemes
subtopics.summary: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that Scheduled Caste status is limited to Hindus, Sikhs and Buddhists, so conversion to another religion leads to loss of SC status. Parliament passed the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, naming Amaravati as the sole capital. Several government schemes were also extended or expanded, including the PM Internship Scheme and PMGSY-III.
facts: SC status limited to Hindus, Sikhs and Buddhists under the Constitution (SC) Order, 1950
Conversion to another religion leads to loss of SC status
Doctrine of Eclipse: SC status is suspended, not permanently extinguished
Re-conversion to Hinduism, Sikhism or Buddhism can restore SC status
Only Parliament can amend the SC list
AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 declares Amaravati as the sole capital
The AP amendment has retrospective effect from 2 June 2024
PM Internship Scheme: age 18-25 years; target of 1 crore internships over 5 years
PMGSY-III extended till March 2028; funding 60:40 (plain states) and 90:10 (NE and Himalayan states)
Namo Drone Didi Yojana: target of 15,000 drones for SHGs; Karnataka is top performer

subtopics.title: Economy and Climate
subtopics.summary: India slipped from 4th to 6th largest economy in nominal GDP in the IMF's World Economic Outlook 2026, behind the UK and Japan. India withdrew its bid to host COP33 in 2028, and it will halt HFC production clearances after 31 December 2027. Under NDC 3.0, India targets a 47 per cent cut in emission intensity from 2005 levels.
facts: India slipped from 4th to 6th largest economy in nominal GDP (IMF WEO 2026)
Ranking fell behind the United Kingdom and Japan
Reasons include GDP data revision with a new 2026 base year and rupee depreciation
SAED is an indirect tax under Section 147 of the Finance Act, 2002
SAED is revised every 2 weeks based on global crude prices and works as a windfall tax
SAED revenue is not shared with states, unlike GST
Dholera (Gujarat): first semiconductor fabrication SEZ, led by Tata Semiconductor with Taiwan's PSMC
India withdrew its bid to host COP33 (2028) under UNFCCC
HFC production clearances to be halted after 31 December 2027
NDC 3.0: 47 per cent emission intensity cut from 2005 levels; 60 per cent non-fossil capacity

subtopics.title: Historical Events and Personalities
subtopics.summary: The 1526 Battle of Panipat between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi marked the foundation of the Mughal Empire in India. The section also covers the Sikh Gurus, the 1919 Jallianwala Bagh Massacre, Shaheed Diwas, and the reformers Jyotirao Phule and B. R. Ambedkar. Guru Tegh Bahadur was executed in Delhi on the orders of Aurangzeb.
facts: First Battle of Panipat on 21 April 1526 between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi
Babur used the Tulughma strategy, Rumi (Ottoman) style artillery and matchlocks
Guru Nanak Dev, first Sikh Guru, started Guru ka Langar
Guru Arjun Dev composed the Adi Granth in 1604
Guru Tegh Bahadur (9th Guru) founded Anandpur Sahib and was executed in Delhi on orders of Aurangzeb
Jallianwala Bagh Massacre on 13 April 1919; official death toll 379
Shaheed Diwas on 23 March marks the 1931 execution of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru
Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873 and opened a girls' school in Pune in 1848
Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constitution and converted to Buddhism in 1956
Ambedkar received the Bharat Ratna (posthumous, 1990)

quizzes.passage:
Digital platforms faced major legal and regulatory scrutiny in April 2026. A jury in the United States found Meta Platforms and YouTube liable for designing addictive products, such as endless scrolling and algorithm-driven feeds. The ruling treated the problem as one of platform design rather than the content users posted. The court did not apply the usual shield under Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act, and the platforms were treated as products. Liability was divided between the two companies.

In India, the government has notified rules for online gaming that take effect from 1 May 2026. These rules work alongside a law that prohibits online money gaming, meaning betting and wagering, while allowing e-sports and social or casual games. Games are assessed through a determination test, and registered platforms receive a digital certificate of registration. The framework also bans advertising of money gaming and requires banks and payment gateways to block transactions linked to prohibited platforms.

The Unified Payments Interface completed ten years in 2026 and shows how digital payments are growing. It allows instant bank-to-bank transfers through mobile phones and supports both peer-to-peer and peer-to-merchant payments. Its family of products extends to several other services designed for different users.

questions.q: Which body regulates online gaming under the new framework?
What is the maximum imprisonment under the online gaming penalty provisions?

Assertion (A): Online money gaming is prohibited under the new framework.
Reason (R): Registered e-sports with pre-declared prize pools are exempt from the monetary ban.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quizzes.passage:
Diplomacy in April 2026 focused on two very different relationships. The United States and Iran agreed to a temporary ceasefire after a prolonged conflict, which paused the escalation of tensions in the region. Formal peace talks were planned to follow, and they were to be led by the United States Vice President. The arrangement remained fragile. The United States kept its military forces ready for combat, and Iran warned that it could close the Strait of Hormuz again if hostilities continued. The nuclear issue also stayed unresolved, with Washington demanding the complete dismantling of key nuclear sites.

India and South Korea, meanwhile, moved their ties forward during a visit by South Korean President Lee Jae-myung. The two countries elevated their relationship to a Futuristic Partnership under a Joint Strategic Vision. Several agreements were signed, including cooperation on maritime skills and training. The partners also agreed to work together on artificial intelligence, next-generation information technology and joint research and development. Trade between the two countries is large, and South Korea has become a major investor in India. Defence cooperation includes the co-production of the K9 Vajra-T gun system, and the two sides plan to mark a shared friendship year in the future.
